title: Base-stalk localization of a single root factor
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, f in R, d a positive integer, H=R[T]/(T^d-f), q:Spec H to Spec R the canonical structural map, and w a prime of H. Suppose f belongs to q(w). Set R0=O_(Spec R,q(w)). There exist f0 in the maximal ideal of R0, a maximal ideal P of D=R0[T]/(T^d-f0), and a ring isomorphism theta:O_(Spec H,w) to D_P, such that theta composed with the stalk map of q is the composite R0 to D to D_P. Both polynomial quotients are the concrete AdjoinRoot quotients. The structural map q may be presented with an equality to the canonical map.

source.place: Tags 0EYH and 0EYI: affine root charts, localization and base change of individual root factors

proof.text: Set R0 equal to the actual base stalk and f0 equal to the image of f under its coefficient map. IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff proves the required membership. The proved private helper adjoinRoot_isLocalization_map combines Polynomial.isLocalization with IsLocalization.of_surjective and the principal-ideal kernel of AdjoinRoot.mk. Thus D is the localization of H at the images of the complement of the contracted prime.

Construct P explicitly as the image of the prime w in D. Its disjointness from the coefficient denominators gives primality and contraction back to w by IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint and under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint. The injectivity of IsLocalization.orderEmbedding on the base localization identifies the contraction of P to R0 with its maximal ideal. The positive exponent makes the root polynomial monic; Polynomial.Monic.finite_adjoinRoot gives integrality. Ideal.isMaximal_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal_comap then proves that P is maximal.

Apply IsLocalization.isLocalization_isLocalization_atPrime_isLocalization to identify D_P as a localization of H at w. The spectrum stalk is the same localization, so IsLocalization.algEquiv constructs theta. Compare the coefficient maps using IsLocalization.ringHom_ext on the base localization. The proved private helper spec_stalkMap_toStalk is Mathlib stalkMap_toStalk_apply transported along hq; together with AlgEquiv.commutes and AdjoinRoot.map_of it gives the displayed structural-map equality.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0EYH and 0EYI, root-chart localization argument; Lean assembly from Mathlib polynomial localization, quotient localization, prime correspondence, integrality, and affine stalk compatibility.

mathlib_searches.query: The stalk at a prime of a monic root polynomial quotient is the localization of the quotient over the base stalk
Localization of AdjoinRoot polynomial commutes with localization of the coefficient ring
mathlib_searches.results: Polynomial.isLocalization (Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.Algebra) gives polynomial localization, but not the quotient and prime-stalk identification; Localization.awayEquivAdjoin treats inverse adjunction only.

Localization.AtPrime.mapPiEvalRingHom_bijective, PrimeSpectrum.sigmaToPi_bijective and AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme sigmaSpec give the product-factor part. The private root_local lemma in StalkNormalizationTraitSectionRootPresentation is downstream and cannot be imported. No matching base-localization quotient theorem found.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Ingredients only; product-factor part proved in the delivery.

lean.statement:
theorem rootFactor_stalk_localization (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (f : R)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (q : Spec (CommRingCat.of
      (AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ d - Polynomial.C f))) ⟶ Spec R)
    (hq : q = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R
      (AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ d - Polynomial.C f)))))
    (w : Spec (CommRingCat.of
      (AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ d - Polynomial.C f))))
    (hf : f ∈ (q w).asIdeal) :
    let R₀ := (Spec R).presheaf.stalk (q w)
    ∃ (f₀ : R₀), f₀ ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R₀ ∧
      let p := (Polynomial.X : Polynomial R₀) ^ d - Polynomial.C f₀
      let D := AdjoinRoot p
      ∃ (P : Ideal D) (hP : P.IsMaximal),
        letI : P.IsPrime := hP.isPrime
        let E := Localization.AtPrime P
        ∃ θ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of
          (AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ d - Polynomial.C f)))).presheaf.stalk w
            ≃+* E,
          θ.toRingHom.comp (q.stalkMap w).hom =
            (algebraMap D E).comp (AdjoinRoot.of p)
